title: Logo Folio
discipline: LOGO DESIGN · BRAND IDENTITY · CONCEPT EXPLORATION
subtitle: Six Brands. Six Stories. Six Unique Identities.
eyebrow: Self-initiated concept collection · AI-assisted visual study
summary: A collection of six fictional brand identities exploring distinctive typography, illustrative symbols, visual storytelling, and applications across different industries.
projectType: Self-initiated concept collection · AI-assisted visual study
coverAlt: Editorial Logo Folio cover featuring six fictional brand identity concepts

brands.name: brùlè
brands.concept: A tactile coffee identity with expressive serif letterforms and a leaf-and-bean mark, applied across coffee packaging, ceramics, and signage.

brands.name: vèrda
brands.concept: A botanical wellness direction combining an elegant wordmark, leaf symbolism, deep greens, and quiet product photography.

brands.name: nína
brands.concept: A high-contrast fashion wordmark with unexpected accents, expressive editorial typography, and tactile labels and accessories.

brands.name: lùmora
brands.concept: A destination-led hospitality identity featuring a stylized horizon motif, refined typography, and atmospheric coastal imagery.

brands.name: tála
brands.concept: An expressive food identity driven by a hand-drawn-style wordmark, lively red and orange tones, and an illustrated tomato mark.

brands.name: pixel drift
brands.concept: A modern digital identity mixing chunky contemporary typography, luminous gradients, and a fluid abstract graphic symbol.

title: CareConnect
subtitle: Everyday warmth, designed for care.
summary: A ten-screen mobile UI concept that helps a parent manage everyday medication and check-ins while family caregivers receive clear, permission-based updates.

title: No Cheat Progelato
subtitle: Seven flavours. One visual family.
summary: A seven-flavour packaging range for No Cheat Progelato, presented through pouch artwork, individual mockups, and a cohesive full-family visual.
coverAlt: Seven colourful No Cheat Progelato pouches arranged together on stone podiums

title: Aara — Tea & Stillness
subtitle: A quieter kind of everyday ritual.
summary: A conceptual identity for an imagined Indian tea label, exploring stillness through refined serif typography, botanical illustration, earthy tones and coordinated packaging.
status: Self-initiated concept, not commissioned client work
coverAlt: Aara tea brand concept display with green and ivory cartons, olive tea tin, and stationery
